name: nedls
description: Nim (and C, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, JSON) with ned's own engine: completion, hover, definition, references, rename, call and type hierarchy, formatting, quick fixes and problems as you type — no nimsuggest needed.

nedls.path.description: The nedls program: its name on PATH, or its full path.

nedls.languages.description: The languages nedls answers for. Add c, cpp, javascript, html, css, sql or json to have ned's own engines for them too (turn off other extensions' servers for those).

nedls.inlayHints.description: Type hints after let/var/const, and parameter names in calls.

nedls.parameterHints.description: Parameter names before arguments: before literals, before every argument, or never.

nedls.raisesHints.description: What a routine can raise, as a hint after its header.

nedls.checkOnSave.description: `nim check` the file when it is saved.

nedls.liveDiagnostics.description: Check the unsaved text while typing.

nedls.workspaceDiagnostics.description: The problems of the project's files that are not open too: ned's checks go over them while nedls is idle, and they are listed in the Problems panel.

nedls.formatLineLength.description: The formatter's line length (40–240); not given: nim.format.lineLength, else the file's .editorconfig.

nedls.nedSettings.description: Also read ned's own settings files (~/.config/ned/config.json, .ned/settings.json).

nedls.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and nedls (Output › nedls).
